answer: Farming becomes an atlas bet on surviving 58 epochs of grading, and every garden settlement recomputes the plume schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 6 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 58 epochs rather than arriving at once. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
